
```python
venmo_password = next(p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name'] == 'venmo')
login_result = apis.venmo.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)
print(login_result)
```

```python

```



```python
contacts = apis.phone.search_contacts(query='Stacy')

```

```python
stacy = contacts[0]
print(stacy)
```

```python
request_result = apis.venmo.request_money(
    access_token=login_result['access_token'],
    recipient_venmo_id=stacy['venmo_id'],
    amount=13.0,
    note="For yesterday's meal",
    is_public=True
)
print(request_result)
```

```python
apis.supervisor.complete_task()
```
